recognize_zh: 一顆比周圍小淋巴球大上數倍的巨大組織球，小而深染的細胞核偏在一側，細胞質豐富、淡藍色，呈纖細條紋狀、像揉皺的面紙（crumpled tissue paper）；這種細胞質紋理是高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）的特徵。
features: Very large round histiocyte, many times the size of the adjacent small lymphocytes
Small, eccentric, dense nucleus with irregular contour; low N:C ratio
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with fine fibrillary striations giving a crumpled tissue paper or wrinkled silk texture
No discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles, granules, or phagocytosed cells
Adjacent small mature lymphoid/erythroid cells for scale; smudged background material
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a very large histiocyte adjacent to two small mononuclear cells. The histiocyte has a small, dense, eccentrically placed nucleus and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with a fine fibrillary, striated texture resembling crumpled tissue paper. No foamy vacuolation, sea-blue granules, or phagocytosed hematopoietic cells are identified. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme activity or GBA1 genetic testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar, so they are separated by the underlying disorder and normal glucocerebrosidase activity; mycobacterial pseudo-Gaucher cells are AFB-positive.
Niemann-Pick cells have uniformly foamy, soap-bubble vacuolated cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green ceroid granules rather than a fine wrinkled cytoplasmic texture.
Megakaryocytes have large lobulated nuclei and finely granular pink cytoplasm with platelet budding, not a small eccentric nucleus with striated cytoplasm.
